description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping Tui and La.
Tui and La's first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Honor-Worn Shaku ability, untapping it.
Activate Tui and La by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Tui and La's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.name: Tui and La, Moon and Ocean
